WITH batting_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match,
        COUNT(*) as balls_faced_in_match,
        MAX(bs.runs_scored) as highest_in_match,
        CASE WHEN SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_30_plus,
        CASE WHEN SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_50_plus,
        CASE WHEN SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_100_plus
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
player_batting AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_in_match) as total_runs,
        SUM(balls_faced_in_match) as total_balls_faced,
        MAX(highest_in_match) as highest_score,
        SUM(has_30_plus) as total_matches_30_plus,
        SUM(has_50_plus) as total_matches_50_plus,
        SUM(has_100_plus) as total_matches_100_plus
    FROM batting_stats
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        player_out as player_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
player_roles AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        role,
        COUNT(*) as role_count
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        role as most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            player_id,
            role,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY role_count DESC) as rn
        FROM player_roles
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_wickets_taken AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_in_match,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_given_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
player_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(wickets_in_match) as total_wickets,
        SUM(runs_given_in_match) as total_runs_given
    FROM player_wickets_taken
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled_in_match,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_conceded_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
player_bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(balls_bowled_in_match) as total_balls_bowled,
        SUM(runs_conceded_in_match) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM player_bowling
    GROUP BY player_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets_in_match,
        runs_given_in_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets_in_match DESC, runs_given_in_match ASC) as rn
    FROM player_wickets_taken
),
best_bowling_per_player AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets_in_match as best_wickets,
        runs_given_in_match as best_runs_given
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    COALESCE(pm.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) / COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 1) ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(pb.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(pb.total_matches_30_plus, 0) as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.total_matches_50_plus, 0) as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.total_matches_100_plus, 0) as matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) / COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 1)) * 100 ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(pw.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pbs.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(pbs.total_runs_conceded, 0) / COALESCE(pbs.total_balls_bowled, 1)) * 6 ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbp.best_wickets || '-' || bbp.best_runs_given as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_batting pb ON p.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_wickets pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_bowling_stats pbs ON p.player_id = pbs.player_id
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_per_player bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 10

        SUM(runs_conceded_in_match) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM player_bowling
    GROUP BY player_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets_in_match,
        runs_given_in_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets_in_match DESC, runs_given_in_match ASC) as rn
    FROM player_wickets_taken
),
best_bowling_per_player AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets_in_match as best_wickets,
        runs_given_in_match as best_runs_given
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    COALESCE(pm.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) / COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 1) ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(pb.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(pb.total_matches_30_plus, 0) as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.total_matches_50_plus, 0) as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.total_matches_100_plus, 0) as matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(pb.total_runs, 0) / COALESCE(pb.total_balls_faced, 1)) * 100 ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(pw.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pbs.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(pbs.total_runs_conceded, 0) / COALESCE(pbs.total_balls_bowled, 1)) * 6 ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbp.best_wickets || '-' || bbp.best_runs_given as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_batting pb ON p.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_wickets pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_bowling_stats pbs ON p.player_id = pbs.player_id
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_per_player bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 10
